verses.original: כִּ֗י הִנֵּ֛ה הָהֵ֖מָּה בַּיָּמִ֥ים הַהִ֑יא וּבָעֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָשׁוּב אֶת־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ שְׁב֥וּת
verses.transliteration: kî hin·nêh hā·hêm·māh bay·yā·mîm ha·hî ū·ḇā·‘êṯ ’ă·šer ʾå̄·šūḇ ’eṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh wî·rū·šā·lim šə·ḇūṯ
verses.literal: Yes . . . in those days and at that time when I restore - Judah and Jerusalem from captivity

verses.original: וְקִבַּצְתִּי֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְה֣וֹרַדְתִּ֔ים אֶל־ עֵ֖מֶק יְהֽוֹשָׁפָ֑ט שָׁ֗ם וְנִשְׁפַּטְתִּ֨י עִמָּ֜ם עַל־ עַמִּ֨י וְנַחֲלָתִ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר פִּזְּר֣וּ בַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְאֶת־ חִלֵּֽקוּ׃ אַרְצִ֖י
verses.transliteration: wə·qib·baṣ·tî ’eṯ- kāl- hag·gō·w·yim wə·hō·w·raḏ·tîm ’el- ‘ê·meq yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ šām wə·niš·paṭ·tî ‘im·mām ‘al- ‘am·mî wə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯî yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer piz·zə·rū ḇag·gō·w·yim wə·’eṯ- ḥil·lê·qū ’ar·ṣî
verses.literal: I will gather - all the nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat There I will enter into judgment against them concerning My people My inheritance Israel whom they have scattered among the nations as they divided up My land

verses.original: יַדּ֣וּ גוֹרָ֑ל וְאֶל־ עַמִּ֖י וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ הַיֶּ֙לֶד֙ בַּזּוֹנָ֔ה מָכְר֥וּ וְהַיַּלְדָּ֛ה בַיַּ֖יִן וַיִּשְׁתּֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yad·dū ḡō·w·rāl wə·’el- ‘am·mî way·yit·tə·nū hay·ye·leḏ baz·zō·w·nāh mā·ḵə·rū wə·hay·yal·dāh ḇay·ya·yin way·yiš·tū
verses.literal: They cast lots for My people they bartered a boy for a prostitute and sold a girl for wine to drink

verses.original: וְ֠גַם מָה־ אַתֶּ֥ם לִי֙ צֹ֣ר וְצִיד֔וֹן וְכֹ֖ל גְּלִיל֣וֹת פְּלָ֑שֶׁת אַתֶּם֙ מְשַׁלְּמִ֣ים עָלָ֔י הַגְּמ֗וּל וְאִם־ אַתֶּם֙ גֹּמְלִ֤ים עָלַ֔י קַ֣ל מְהֵרָ֔ה אָשִׁ֥יב גְּמֻלְכֶ֖ם בְּרֹאשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam māh- ’at·tem lî ṣōr wə·ṣî·ḏō·wn wə·ḵōl gə·lî·lō·wṯ pə·lā·šeṯ ’at·tem mə·šal·lə·mîm ‘ā·lāy hag·gə·mūl wə·’im- ’at·tem gō·mə·lîm ‘ā·lay qal mə·hê·rāh ’ā·šîḇ gə·mul·ḵem bə·rō·šə·ḵem
verses.literal: Now what do you have against Me O Tyre Sidon and all the regions of Philistia Are you rendering against Me a recompense If you retaliate against Me I will swiftly and speedily return your recompense upon your heads

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ לְקַחְתֶּ֑ם כַּסְפִּ֥י וּזְהָבִ֖י הֲבֵאתֶ֖ם הַטֹּבִ֔ים וּמַֽחֲמַדַּי֙ לְהֵיכְלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer- lə·qaḥ·tem kas·pî ū·zə·hā·ḇî hă·ḇê·ṯem haṭ·ṭō·ḇîm ū·ma·ḥă·mad·day lə·hê·ḵə·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: For you took My silver and gold and carried off My finest treasures to your temples

verses.original: מְכַרְתֶּ֖ם לִבְנֵ֣י וּבְנֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וּבְנֵ֣י הַיְּוָנִ֑ים לְמַ֥עַן הַרְחִיקָ֖ם מֵעַ֥ל גְּבוּלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mə·ḵar·tem liḇ·nê ū·ḇə·nê yə·hū·ḏāh yə·rū·šā·lim ū·ḇə·nê hay·yə·wā·nîm lə·ma·‘an har·ḥî·qām mê·‘al gə·ḇū·lām
verses.literal: You sold . . . the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks . . . to send them far from their homeland

verses.original: הִנְנִ֣י מְעִירָ֔ם מִן־ הַ֨מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ מְכַרְתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֖ם שָׁ֑מָּה וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֥י גְמֻלְכֶ֖ם בְּרֹאשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nî mə·‘î·rām min- ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer- mə·ḵar·tem ’ō·ṯām šām·māh wa·hă·ši·ḇō·ṯî ḡə·mul·ḵem bə·rō·šə·ḵem
verses.literal: Behold I will rouse them from the places to which you sold them . . . I will return your recompense upon your heads

verses.original: וּמָכַרְתִּ֞י אֶת־ בְּנֵיכֶ֣ם וְאֶת־ בְּנֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם בְּיַד֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּמְכָר֥וּם לִשְׁבָאיִ֖ם אֶל־ רָח֑וֹק גּ֣וֹי כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mā·ḵar·tî ’eṯ- bə·nê·ḵem wə·’eṯ- bə·nō·w·ṯê·ḵem bə·yaḏ bə·nê yə·hū·ḏāh ū·mə·ḵā·rūm liš·ḇā·yim ’el- rā·ḥō·wq gō·w kî Yah·weh dib·bêr
verses.literal: I will sell - your sons - and daughters into the hands of the people of Judah and they will sell them to the Sabeans to a distant nation Indeed the LORD has spoken

verses.original: קִרְאוּ־ זֹאת֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם קַדְּשׁ֖וּ מִלְחָמָ֑ה הָעִ֙ירוּ֙ הַגִּבּוֹרִ֔ים כֹּ֖ל אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃ יִגְּשׁ֣וּ יַֽעֲל֔וּ
verses.transliteration: qir·’ū- zōṯ bag·gō·w·yim qad·də·šū mil·ḥā·māh hā·‘î·rū hag·gib·bō·w·rîm kōl ’an·šê ham·mil·ḥā·māh yig·gə·šū ya·‘ă·lū
verses.literal: Proclaim this among the nations Prepare for war rouse the mighty men let all the men of war advance and attack

verses.original: כֹּ֤תּוּ אִתֵּיכֶם֙ לַֽחֲרָב֔וֹת וּמַזְמְרֹֽתֵיכֶ֖ם לִרְמָחִ֑ים הַֽחַלָּ֔שׁ יֹאמַ֖ר אָֽנִי׃ גִּבּ֥וֹר
verses.transliteration: kōt·tū ’it·tê·ḵem la·ḥă·rā·ḇō·wṯ ū·maz·mə·rō·ṯê·ḵem lir·mā·ḥîm ha·ḥal·lāš yō·mar ’ā·nî gib·bō·wr
verses.literal: Beat your plowshares into swords and your pruning hooks into spears Let the weak say I [am] strong

verses.original: וָבֹ֧אוּ ע֣וּשׁוּ כָֽל־ מִסָּבִ֖יב הַגּוֹיִ֛ם וְנִקְבָּ֑צוּ הַֽנְחַ֥ת גִּבּוֹרֶֽיךָ׃ שָׁ֕מָּה יְהוָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: wā·ḇō·’ū ‘ū·šū ḵāl mis·sā·ḇîḇ hag·gō·w·yim wə·niq·bā·ṣū han·ḥaṯ gib·bō·w·re·ḵā šām·māh Yah·weh
verses.literal: Come quickly all {you} surrounding nations and gather yourselves Bring down Your mighty ones - O LORD

verses.original: הַגּוֹיִ֔ם יֵע֙וֹרוּ֙ וְיַעֲל֣וּ אֶל־ עֵ֖מֶק יְהֽוֹשָׁפָ֑ט כִּ֣י שָׁ֗ם אֵשֵׁ֛ב לִשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶת־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם מִסָּבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: hag·gō·w·yim yê·‘ō·w·rū wə·ya·‘ă·lū ’el- ‘ê·meq yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ kî šām ’ê·šêḇ liš·pōṭ ’eṯ- kāl- hag·gō·w·yim mis·sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: Let the nations be roused and advance to the Valley of Jehoshaphat for there I will sit down to judge - all the nations on every side

verses.original: שִׁלְח֣וּ מַגָּ֔ל כִּ֥י קָצִ֑יר בָשַׁ֖ל בֹּ֤אֽוּ רְדוּ֙ כִּֽי־ גַּ֔ת מָ֣לְאָה הַיְקָבִ֔ים הֵשִׁ֙יקוּ֙ כִּ֥י רָעָתָֽם׃ רַבָּ֖ה
verses.transliteration: šil·ḥū mag·gāl kî qā·ṣîr ḇā·šal bō·’ū rə·ḏū kî- gaṯ mā·lə·’āh hay·qā·ḇîm hê·šî·qū kî rā·‘ā·ṯām rab·bāh
verses.literal: Swing the sickle for the harvest is ripe Come trample the grapes for the winepress is full the wine vats overflow because their wickedness is great

verses.original: הֲמוֹנִ֣ים הֲמוֹנִ֔ים בְּעֵ֖מֶק הֶֽחָר֑וּץ כִּ֤י י֣וֹם יְהוָ֔ה קָרוֹב֙ בְּעֵ֖מֶק הֶחָרֽוּץ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·mō·w·nîm hă·mō·w·nîm bə·‘ê·meq he·ḥā·rūṣ kî yō·wm Yah·weh qā·rō·wḇ bə·‘ê·meq he·ḥā·rūṣ
verses.literal: Multitudes multitudes in the valley of decision For the Day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision

verses.original: שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ וְיָרֵ֖חַ קָדָ֑רוּ וְכוֹכָבִ֖ים אָסְפ֥וּ נָגְהָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: še·meš wə·yā·rê·aḥ qā·ḏā·rū wə·ḵō·w·ḵā·ḇîm ’ā·sə·p̄ū nā·ḡə·hām
verses.literal: The sun and moon will grow dark and the stars {will} no longer shine

verses.original: וַיהוָ֞ה יִשְׁאָ֗ג מִצִּיּ֣וֹן יִתֵּ֣ן קוֹל֔וֹ וּמִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ שָׁמַ֣יִם וָאָ֑רֶץ וְרָעֲשׁ֖וּ וַֽיהוָה֙ מַֽחֲסֶ֣ה לְעַמּ֔וֹ וּמָע֖וֹז לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yiš·’āḡ miṣ·ṣî·yō·wn yit·tên qō·w·lōw ū·mî·rū·šā·lim šā·ma·yim wā·’ā·reṣ wə·rā·‘ă·šū Yah·weh ma·ḥă·seh lə·‘am·mōw ū·mā·‘ō·wz liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: The LORD will roar from Zion and raise His voice from Jerusalem heaven and earth will tremble But the LORD will be a refuge for His people a stronghold for the people of Israel

verses.original: וִֽידַעְתֶּ֗ם כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם שֹׁכֵ֖ן בְּצִיּ֣וֹן קָדְשִׁ֑י הַר־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ וְהָיְתָ֤ה קֹ֔דֶשׁ לֹא־ עֽוֹד׃ס יַֽעַבְרוּ־ וְזָרִ֥ים בָ֖הּ
verses.transliteration: wî·ḏa‘·tem kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem šō·ḵên bə·ṣî·yō·wn qāḏ·šî har- yə·rū·šā·lim wə·hā·yə·ṯāh qō·ḏeš lō- ‘ō·wḏ ya·‘aḇ·rū- wə·zā·rîm ḇāh
verses.literal: Then you will know that I am the LORD your God who dwells in Zion My holy mountain Jerusalem will be holy never again to be overrun by foreigners

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ הַה֜וּא בַיּ֨וֹם הֶהָרִ֣ים יִטְּפ֧וּ עָסִ֗יס וְהַגְּבָעוֹת֙ תֵּלַ֣כְנָה חָלָ֔ב וְכָל־ אֲפִיקֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה יֵ֣לְכוּ מָ֑יִם וּמַעְיָ֗ן יֵצֵ֔א מִבֵּ֤ית יְהוָה֙ וְהִשְׁקָ֖ה אֶת־ נַ֥חַל הַשִּׁטִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ha·hū ḇay·yō·wm he·hā·rîm yiṭ·ṭə·p̄ū ‘ā·sîs wə·hag·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ tê·laḵ·nāh ḥā·lāḇ wə·ḵāl ’ă·p̄î·qê yə·hū·ḏāh yê·lə·ḵū mā·yim ū·ma‘·yān yê·ṣê mib·bêṯ Yah·weh wə·hiš·qāh ’eṯ- na·ḥal haš·šiṭ·ṭîm
verses.literal: And in that day the mountains will drip with sweet wine and the hills will flow with milk All the streams of Judah will run with water and a spring will flow from the house of the LORD to water - the Valley of Acacias

verses.original: מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ תִֽהְיֶ֔ה לִשְׁמָמָ֣ה וֶאֱד֕וֹם לְמִדְבַּ֥ר שְׁמָמָ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶ֑ה מֵֽחֲמַס֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ בְּאַרְצָֽם׃ שָׁפְכ֥וּ נָקִ֖יא דָם־
verses.transliteration: miṣ·ra·yim ṯih·yeh liš·mā·māh we·’ĕ·ḏō·wm lə·miḏ·bar šə·mā·māh tih·yeh mê·ḥă·mas bə·nê yə·hū·ḏāh ’ă·šer- bə·’ar·ṣām šā·p̄ə·ḵū nā·qî ḏām-
verses.literal: Egypt will become desolate and Edom a desert wasteland because of the violence done to the people of Judah in whose land they shed innocent blood

verses.original: וִיהוּדָ֖ה תֵּשֵׁ֑ב לְעוֹלָ֣ם וִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לְד֥וֹר וָדֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: wî·hū·ḏāh tê·šêḇ lə·‘ō·w·lām wî·rū·šā·lim lə·ḏō·wr wā·ḏō·wr
verses.literal: But Judah will be inhabited forever . . . and Jerusalem from generation to generation

verses.original: וְנִקֵּ֖יתִי דָּמָ֣ם לֹֽא־ נִקֵּ֑יתִי וַֽיהוָ֖ה שֹׁכֵ֥ן בְּצִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·niq·qê·ṯî dā·mām lō- niq·qê·ṯî Yah·weh šō·ḵên bə·ṣî·yō·wn
verses.literal: For I will avenge their blood which I have not yet avenged For the LORD dwells in Zion
